name: Mau-Mau
summary: Shedding card game where players match rank or suit to discard all cards first, with power cards.
rules_text: Use 32 cards (7-A) or two packs for 6+ players. Deal 5-6 cards each, rest as draw stock, flip one to start discard pile. On your turn play a card matching suit or rank of top discard; Jack is wild and lets you call a suit. If you cannot, draw one and play it if possible. 7 forces next player to draw two (stackable), 8 forces skip, Ace requires a second card played with it. When down to one card say Mau, two if last is Jack say Mau-Mau, else penalty draw. Drawing pile exhausted: shuffle discard except top card. First to empty hand wins, must announce.
rating_reason: Specific shedding game, hidden hands, turn-based strategic
